biggest_catch: Only the referrer earns the $100 credit (the new customer gets nothing stated), and both sides face steep qualification bars: the new customer must be a whole-house fuel account on automatic delivery with a 600-gallon annual minimum, and you must already be an active whole-house automatic-delivery customer in good standing.
catches: Only the referring customer receives the $100 account credit; the referred customer gets no stated reward.
The new customer must set up automatic delivery on a whole-house fuel account with a 600-gallon annual minimum (or forecasted annual minimum) and pass a credit or equipment check.
The referring customer must be set up on automatic delivery with an active whole-house fuel account in good standing.
New customers cannot cancel a delivery or switch from automatic delivery to will-call; existing delivery locations, metered accounts, and existing tanks are excluded.
Contractor, builder, and commercial accounts are not eligible.
Credits are non-transferable, non-refundable, not redeemable for cash, and may only be applied toward R. H. Foster products and services.
Cannot be combined with any other offers; both accounts must be in good standing.
R. H. Foster Energy's service area only.
